segment.time: Day, cool daylight through the tall left windows and a flat fluorescent wash
segment.first_state: Funeral hall. The axis runs from the mourners to the bier. The camera stays on the window side, so the bier is always at screen right and the mourners face screen right. There is one bier at the screen-right end, covered with one white cloth, with one framed black-and-white portrait above it. Paper wreaths stand on wooden stands along both walls. The one pair of double wooden doors is behind the mourners at screen left. Si Yi stands at the head of the bier, facing screen left toward the mourners, hands folded. Si Nian lies still under the white cloth on the bier in burial clothes, feet toward the mourners, out of view in this segment. Si Xin stands in the front row nearest the camera and Zhang Cuimei stands at his far side, both facing the bier and off frame in this segment. Bin Ke Jia and Bin Ke Yi stand side by side in the back row among unnamed mourners, Bin Ke Jia nearer the camera, both facing the bier.

shots.camera: Wide shot, high angle from the window side, slow push in toward the bier at screen right
shots.visual: The funeral hall in cool daylight shafts. Rows of mourners face the white-draped bier and the framed portrait at screen right, and Si Yi stands at the head of the bier facing them.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Si Yi, in Mandarin, slow and ceremonial): {请所有来宾全体肃立，}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, low angle on the window side
shots.visual: Si Yi stands beside the bier with his hands folded and slowly lowers his head.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Si Yi, in Mandarin, slow and ceremonial): {为司家的长女默哀。}

shots.camera: Medium close-up two-shot, handheld, eye-level from the window side, back row
shots.visual: In the back row, Bin Ke Jia leans toward Bin Ke Yi and whispers behind her hand, both still facing the bier.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Bin Ke Jia, in Mandarin, curious whisper): {这司先生可是国营化工厂的二把手，}

shots.camera: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level from the window side
shots.visual: Bin Ke Yi raises one eyebrow and gives a knowing smirk.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Bin Ke Jia, in Mandarin, curious whisper): {是城里有头有脸的人物，}

shots.camera: Close-up, slight push in, eye-level from the window side
shots.visual: Bin Ke Jia glances toward the bier and shakes her head in pity.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Bin Ke Jia, in Mandarin, curious whisper): {怎么女儿这么年轻就……}

shots.camera: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Bin Ke Jia's shoulder onto Bin Ke Yi, eye-level, window side
shots.visual: Bin Ke Yi leans close to Bin Ke Jia's ear and keeps his eyes on the bier.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Bin Ke Yi, in Mandarin, smug low murmur): {你没听说啊，司家跟一个农村种地的抱错了孩子，}

shots.camera: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level from the window side
shots.visual: Bin Ke Jia's eyes widen and she covers her mouth with her hand.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Bin Ke Yi, in Mandarin, smug low murmur): {现在亲生女儿找回来了。}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, handheld, eye-level from the window side
shots.visual: Bin Ke Yi tips his chin toward the bier and then toward the front row, lowering his voice further.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Bin Ke Yi, in Mandarin, smug low murmur): {死的这个听说要替真千金嫁给乡下离过婚的老男人，}

shots.camera: Medium shot, high angle, slow push in on the bier at screen right
shots.visual: Insert of the bier: the still white cloth over the body and the black-and-white portrait frame above it, with paper wreaths on both sides.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Bin Ke Yi, in Mandarin, smug low murmur): {活活让养母给逼死了！}

segment.light_audio: Cool diagonal daylight from the tall left windows, flat pale fluorescent overhead light. Live sound: hushed hall, shuffling feet, soft murmurs.

dialogue.speaker: si_yi
dialogue.line: 请所有来宾全体肃立，为司家的长女默哀。

dialogue.speaker: bin_ke_jia
dialogue.line: 这司先生可是国营化工厂的二把手，是城里有头有脸的人物，怎么女儿这么年轻就……

dialogue.speaker: bin_ke_yi
dialogue.line: 你没听说啊，司家跟一个农村种地的抱错了孩子，现在亲生女儿找回来了。死的这个听说要替真千金嫁给乡下离过婚的老男人，活活让养母给逼死了！

must_hit: Si Yi calls the mourners to stand in silence beside the bier
Bin Ke Jia and Bin Ke Yi whisper the gossip in the back row
The white-draped bier with the portrait is shown
segment.exit_state: Funeral hall. The axis runs from the mourners to the bier. The camera stays on the window side, the bier at screen right, the mourners facing screen right. There is one bier at the screen-right end under one white cloth, with one framed portrait above it. Paper wreaths stand along both walls and the double wooden doors are behind the mourners at screen left. Si Yi stands at the head of the bier facing screen left. Si Nian lies still under the white cloth in burial clothes, feet toward the mourners. Si Xin stands in the front row nearest the camera with Zhang Cuimei at his far side, both facing the bier, ready to bow. Bin Ke Jia and Bin Ke Yi stand in the back row, having finished whispering.
